q: Cremonese keeper Michelangelo Rampulla did something in 1992 no Serie A goalkeeper had managed before. What was it?
a: He scored, heading in an equaliser away at Atalanta.
sub: Last minute, from an Alviero Chiorri free kick.

q: Napoli were handed a 2-0 win at Atalanta in 1990 after Alemao went down at Bergamo. What had hit him?
a: A coin thrown from the stands.
sub: The two points helped Napoli pip Milan to the Scudetto.

q: Which newly promoted club led Serie A for six weeks in 2001-02 and finished fifth?
sub: Fifth put them in the UEFA Cup in their first top flight season.

q: Genoa won Serie B in 2004-05 and did not go up. What happened to them instead?
a: They were sent down to Serie C1 for fixing the final game.
sub: Three points off too, and bottom of the league they had just won.

q: Which Serie B club reached the semi-finals of the 1988 Cup Winners' Cup?
sub: Mechelen knocked them out and went on to win it.

q: Which striker took a pay cut to play for his home town club Livorno and was the Serie A top scorer in 2004-05?
sub: Some players buy a Ferrari, he said, I bought the Livorno shirt.

q: Which Bari striker shared the 1995-96 Serie A top scorer award with Giuseppe Signori while his club went down?
sub: Twenty-four goals, and Bari finished fifteenth.

q: Which striker stayed with Fiorentina after they went down in 1993 and scored sixteen goals to take them straight back up?
sub: Claudio Ranieri was the manager who took them up.

q: AC Milan fans protested outside the club offices in January 2009 to stop Kaka joining which club?
sub: Berlusconi called the bid off within days.

q: Inter Milan sacked Rafael Benitez in December 2010 five days after he had won which trophy?
sub: They had slid to sixth in Serie A, thirteen points off the top.

q: Palermo owner Maurizio Zamparini got through more than forty of what in fifteen years at the club?
sub: He bought Palermo in 2002 and sold up in 2018.

q: The 2004 Rome derby was abandoned early in the second half after a rumour swept the stands. What was the rumour?
a: That police had killed a boy outside the ground. It was untrue.
sub: Totti went to the Curva, then asked for the game to be called off.

q: Which club started the 2006-07 season with a fifteen point deduction for Calciopoli?
sub: They had been docked nineteen the season before as well.

q: Which club was docked ten points in 2022-23 over the way it had accounted for transfers, and finished seventh?
sub: An earlier fifteen point deduction had been overturned on appeal.

q: Silvio Berlusconi presented his new AC Milan squad in 1986 by landing them on the pitch in helicopters. What was playing?
sub: Three helicopters, ten thousand fans, and Baresi first out.
